veranderings.voor: So hoef 'n mens die pad minder kere heen en weer te stap
veranderings.na: So moes 'n mens die pad minder kere heen en weer stap
veranderings.rede: 'Hoef' normally needs a negative, and the present tense breaks the block's past narrative ('kon'); 'moes' fixes both and saves a word.
Countable 'woud' without an article reads unnaturally; the plural is idiomatic and adds no words.
